# Typelessity — full content (llms-full.txt)

> Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces traditional booking forms with natural-language chat in 25+ languages. Built by Webappski. This file concatenates the public pages for LLM ingestion. Last updated 2026-09-25.

---

## Home — https://typelessity.com/

**Hero.** Bookings through conversation, not forms. Typelessity is an AI booking widget that replaces forms with natural chat. Customers describe their needs in any of 25+ languages — the AI extracts dates, times, preferences and personal details automatically. Voice input. Real-time enrichment. Consent before any AI processing; service and database in the EU, OpenAI in the US under the 2021 SCCs; processing under the Typelessity DPA.

**TL;DR.** Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces multi-step forms with a single chat. Users describe their booking in plain language; the widget extracts structured data, validates it, calls enrichment APIs (e.g. fetch available mechanics after a service is chosen), and submits the booking by email, webhook or REST. It supports 25+ languages and voice input, and is configurable for any service-business booking flow.

**Stats.** Languages 25+. Free pilot €0, up to 50 submissions a month. Four phases (Chat → Select → Review → Confirm). Two lines of HTML to integrate.

**Four phases.**
1. Chat — User describes booking in plain language; The AI model — OpenAI (currently gpt-5.4-mini) — reads the field config and extracts values directly. No regex, no hardcoded patterns, no language switches.
2. Select — When options must be exact (a specific mechanic, a specific time slot), the widget renders interactive cards. Triggered by enrichment APIs.
3. Review — Full form review surface. User verifies every extracted field, edits inline if needed. Cascade-aware — changing a field clears downstream-dependent fields with a warning.
4. Confirm — Booking sent to your system: as JSON to your endpoint, shaped by the field mapping, or by email. The success screen shows a reference: the ID your system returned, or our own when it returned none. A 502, 503 or 504 from your endpoint is retried with exponential backoff.

**Architecture pillars.**
- Single unified prompt: one GPT call extracts every field. The prompt is built from the configuration, so its size grows with the fields and options.
- Config-driven, not pattern-driven: aiHint per field; GPT reads context.
- Real-time enrichment APIs: 10 s timeout each by default (configurable), non-fatal on failure.
- Cascade-aware corrections: DFS dependency walk on field changes.
- Guardrails in code: fields the configuration does not define are dropped; a reply claiming a finished booking before confirmation is discarded; a new value for a filled field is treated as a correction. The `_meta.mf` mentioned-fields list is logged for diagnostics, not enforced.
- Reliable by design: exponential-backoff retries on model calls and on booking submission, semaphore-bounded concurrency for model calls, every message stored with its conversation.

**Comparison snapshot.** Use Typelessity when you have an existing booking system and want to replace its form with conversation. Use Calendly for simple meeting links. Use SimplyBook.me for end-to-end booking ops with payments. Use Botpress for custom chatbots. Use NoForm.ai for top-of-funnel lead capture.

---

## How it works — https://typelessity.com/how-it-works

Four phases, one unified flow. Chat → Select → Review → Confirm. One GPT call per turn, real-time enrichment APIs, cascade-aware corrections, no hardcoded regex.

The widget is a Lit web component. The API is a Node service. The AI provider is OpenAI, called through Typelessity's own account; there is no custom provider option. Field schemas are JSON. Per-tenant config selects field types, options, enrichments, branding.

Embed: two lines of HTML — a `<script type="module">` tag loading https://typelessity-widget.vercel.app/widget.js and a `<typelessity-widget api-url="https://typelessity.vercel.app">` element. The embed code comes from your setup in the Webappski portal, which shows the exact code for plain HTML, WordPress, React or Vue.

## Pricing — https://typelessity.com/pricing

The Free Pilot is open, and every tier starts with it: sign in at https://webappski.com/en/portal/login?start=typelessity and set Typelessity up in the portal — step by step, or with your own AI writing the configuration.

**Free Pilot — €0.** Up to 50 submissions/month, 1 website. Full feature access (25+ languages, voice input, enrichment APIs, custom branding, webhook integration) and support by email. Risk-free evaluation on a real site.

**Starter — €39/mo.** Up to 500 submissions/month, up to 5 websites, support by email.

**Pro — €149/mo.** Up to 2,000 submissions/month, up to 10 websites, support by email.

**Enterprise — €399/mo.** Up to 6,000 submissions/month and unlimited sites. An uptime commitment, a named contact and pricing above 6,000 submissions are agreed per contract on request. Hosted only — no on-premise or self-hosted build, no custom AI provider. Support by email, as on every tier.

We do not publish a conversion-lift number. The only honest answer for a specific business is an A/B test on its own traffic.

## Industries — https://typelessity.com/industries

Configurable per service-business vertical. Supported categories (configurations): Beauty & Wellness, Professional Services, Fitness & Sports, Home Services, Automotive, Education, Hospitality, Real Estate, Pet Services. Each vertical has its own configuration; see /industries for the full list.

Medical booking is not a supported use case: the Typelessity DPA does not permit health data (GDPR Article 9), in the US or the EU, and Typelessity is not HIPAA-attested.

---

## For AI agents — https://typelessity.com/for-ai-agents

Session and Booking schemas are published and stable. A dedicated `/agent/turn` endpoint is designed on that page, but it is not built and has no release date.

**Session schema.** `{ id, config, lang, fields, _meta: { mf, correction }, createdAt, completed }`.

**Booking schema.** `{ bookingId, sessionId, fields, submittedAt, status }`.

**Feature list (machine-readable).**
- languages_supported: 25+
- industries_supported: config-driven, see /industries for current verticals
- extraction_model: OpenAI (currently gpt-5.4-mini)
- voice_input: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
- enrichment_timeout_ms: 10000 by default, configurable
- hosting_region: EU (Vercel fra1, Frankfurt)
- database_region: EU (Supabase eu-west-1, Ireland)
- ai_processing_region: US (OpenAI, 2021 SCCs)
- deployment: hosted only, no on-premise build
- training_use: none

Questions about the /agent endpoint: info@webappski.com.

## FAQ — https://typelessity.com/faq

Selection (full FAQ on /faq):

- **What is Typelessity?** AI conversational booking widget replacing multi-step booking forms with a single natural-language chat. 25+ languages, voice via OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, real-time enrichment.
- **How is it different from Calendly?** Calendly is a scheduling-link tool. Typelessity replaces an entire booking form with conversation.
- **How is it different from SimplyBook.me?** SimplyBook is a full booking platform with payments and staff scheduling. Typelessity replaces only the booking form, then submits to your existing backend.
- **GDPR compliant?** You are the controller and Typelessity is your processor under a DPA. On our side: consent from every visitor before any AI processing. Service in the EU (Vercel, Frankfurt), database in the EU (Supabase, Ireland); OpenAI and Resend process in the US under the 2021 SCCs. Abandoned conversations deleted within 48 hours; booked ones kept until the business has them erased (written instruction to info@webappski.com). No model training.
- **Voice input?** Yes — OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe. All 25+ supported languages.
- **Per-turn latency?** Not measured on the current model, so not quoted. One AI call per turn; enrichment turns make a second call.
- **Self-host?** No. Hosted service only — there is no on-premise or self-hosted build.
- **Replace my booking system?** No. Replaces the form, not the backend. Submits by email, webhook or REST POST.
- **Best industries?** Any service business with appointments. Supported verticals (configurations) include beauty salons, legal, real estate, automotive, hospitality, education, fitness, pet services, home services.
- **Works for AI agents?** Not through a dedicated endpoint yet. Session and Booking schemas are published; the `/agent/turn` endpoint is designed, not built, with no release date.

---

## About — https://typelessity.com/about

Mission: replace the booking form with one sentence. Multi-step forms exist because old UI primitives could not parse natural language. They can now.

Founder: Alex Isa. Engineer turned founder. Started the Typelessity engine in January 2026 and took it from specification to the free pilot — single-call extraction architecture, config-driven enrichment, anti-hallucination guards, 25+ language support out of the box.

**Built by Webappski.** Typelessity is a product of Webappski — a small product studio building the next layer of AI-native interfaces for service businesses. Sister product: TypelessForm — the same conversational-data-collection thesis applied to general-purpose forms (lead capture, support intake, onboarding). Typelessity is the booking-specific surface; TypelessForm is the generic one.

Values: GPT decides, code orchestrates. Architecture is permanent, GTM is changeable. Numbers belong with sources. The widget is for humans and agents.

## Legal

Security is served from this domain. The contracts are published by Webappski, the parent company, and live on webappski.com — the typelessity.com paths for them are permanent redirects, not documents.

- Security — https://typelessity.com/legal/security
- Privacy (end users) — https://webappski.com/en/legal/product-privacy
- Terms of Service (B2B) — https://webappski.com/en/legal/terms
- Typelessity DPA, including the sub-processor list (Appendix B) — https://webappski.com/en/legal/dpa-typelessity

Service in the EU (Vercel, Frankfurt) and database in the EU (Supabase, Ireland) for every customer; OpenAI and Resend process in the US under the 2021 SCCs. Consent asked from every visitor before any AI processing begins. No data is used for model training. Abandoned conversations are deleted within 48 hours of the last message; conversations that led to a booking are kept until the business has them erased by written instruction to info@webappski.com. Security reports: info@webappski.com.
